current.text: He is projected to come off the bench. The projected starting guards are Curry and Podziemski.
The starting guard spot next to Curry is unclear among Podziemski, Melton and Santos. He has an outside shot to start.
Steve Kerr often names a starting lineup and changes it a few games later, with a lot of mixing among the wings. His role could shift early in the season.
Golden State's depth is very poor and they struggle to field a 10-man rotation, so minutes should go up across the rotation.
His knee recovery after the ACL injury is still a concern.

If he starts and plays about 28 minutes, he is worth a pickup in every 12-team league and can beat last season's rank of 179. He is not worth it in 10-team leagues. One expert puts him in tier 9 of the point guard rankings.
One expert expects him to do a bit more than last season.
The Warriors may treat this as a gap year. They are worried about lottery odds and may rest veterans, and experts expect Warriors players to fade as the season goes on.
Golden State's schedule is good for fantasy playoffs that end March 28. The team also has 15 back-to-backs, tied for second most.

durable.text: He is a steals specialist. His steals are far above the top 250 pool.
He is a good defender but not a primary creator.
He is a career 36 to 39% three-point shooter. He shot badly last season after coming back from injury.
His FG% is low for a guard on about 11 shots per game.
He has had an ACL injury.

note: Both sites value him at 0 USD (Yahoo rank 245, ESPN rank 180), and he went undrafted in our league last season. That puts him well outside the 144 players we draft, so don't spend a pick on him. Steals (about 1.6) are his one standout category, and his low FG% (about 41% on 11 shots) fits punt FG% builds. Watch the first weeks: if he takes the starting guard spot and plays about 28 minutes, add him right away.
